The '''Stolen Fortune''' was a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] located within the [[Paradise (space station)|Paradise]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. It was there that [[Darth Cognus|the Huntress]] met with [[Lucia (soldier)|Lucia]], a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] working on behalf of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Serra]] of the [[Doan Royal House|royal house]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Doan]].
